capabilities: display a progress bar in the file explorer sidebar
track task completion across single notes or entire folders
configure note types (daily, weekly, monthly, custom) and tracking modes (latest, today, all)
change bar color across 12 levels based on completion percentage
update automatically when notes are modified
extras: Documentation points to an external site for the latest docs; the author asks that donations go to a charity instead of themselves.
intentEvidence: While both Progressive and progress-tracker help visualize task completion, Progressive is a different approach
problem: Obsidian has no always-visible, passive overview of task completion across notes; checking progress requires opening individual notes or embedding trackers.
summary: Sidebar progress bar that shows the percentage of completed tasks across daily, weekly, monthly, or custom notes and folders.
